groups.defect: The Meet location fallback dereferences mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration without optional chaining, so it throws a TypeError when destinationCalendar is null or empty.
groups.rationale: All five report the same missing null guard on the destructured first destination calendar in EventManager, and all propose the same fix.

groups.defect: In GoogleCalendarService updateEvent and deleteEvent, the else-branch fallback searches destinationCalendar for externalId === externalCalendarId while externalCalendarId is falsy, so it never matches and the calendarId is undefined (the old destinationCalendar fallback is lost).
groups.rationale: The same broken find expression was copy-pasted into updateEvent and deleteEvent. Each place needs its own edit, but one approach fixes both, and some members already cover both places.

groups.defect: Calendar.createEvent now takes credentialId, but the Office365, Lark and Base calendar implementations were not updated. They don't accept the parameter, and they always use destinationCalendar[0] instead of picking the calendar that matches the credentialId.
groups.rationale: Every member reports the same interface/implementation mismatch at different implementation sites, and one consistent signature update fixes all of them. Some members also mention the missing per-credential calendar selection.
